# Generated by ppc build from [stored_food] in constructor.toml (stored_food.py); do not edit by hand.

# Province scope. Keeps the province's Stored Food modifier at size = its stored years. The consumption (a loop over
# the province's locations) is worked out once; the modifier is re-applied only when the stored months moved by
# more than 0.05 since the last refresh or the store emptied. Variables and locals carry
# + 100 (a variable at 0 counts as unset); `var:x = n` compares scopes, so only < / > ranges are used.
pp_refresh_stored_food = {
	# old saves: drop the whole-month tier modifier and its variables once
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_1 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_2 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_3 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_4 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_4 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_5 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_5 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_6 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_6 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_7 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_7 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_8 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_8 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_9 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_9 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_10 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_10 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_11 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_11 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_12 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_12 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_13 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_13 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_14 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_14 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_15 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_15 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_16 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_16 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_17 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_17 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_18 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_18 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_19 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_19 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_20 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_20 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_21 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_21 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_22 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_22 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_23 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_23 }
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_24 } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food_tier_24 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_tier }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_next } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_next }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_change } remove_variable = pp_stored_food_tier_change }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_consumption value = { value = pp_stored_food_province_consumption add = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_target value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption > 100 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = pp_stored_food_target
			value = {
				value = province_food
				divide = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_consumption subtract = 100 }
				min = 0
				max = { value = define:NEconomy|GROWTH_FROM_FOOD_MULTIPLIER_MAX multiply = 12 }
				add = 100
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_stored_food_size } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_size value = 100 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_change value = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target subtract = var:pp_stored_food_size add = 100 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				local_var:pp_stored_food_change > 100.05
				local_var:pp_stored_food_change < 99.95
				AND = { local_var:pp_stored_food_target < 100.00001 var:pp_stored_food_size > 100.00001 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = pp_stored_food } remove_province_modifier = pp_stored_food }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:pp_stored_food_target > 100.00001 }
			add_province_modifier = { modifier = pp_stored_food size = { value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target subtract = 100 divide = 12 } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = pp_stored_food_size value = local_var:pp_stored_food_target }
	}
}
